assumptions: Campaign median ROAS is a relevant benchmark.
Improving creative, audience, placement, or landing-page efficiency can increase ROAS.
limitations: A lower relative ROAS is not proof of unprofitability without business margin targets.
No budget target is available for spend comparison.

action_plan.ordering_reason: Higher priority and lower stated implementation effort are ordered first; no deadlines are inferred.
